name: Demon Hotel
source:
You wake up in a pristine-looking hotel, but later find out the hotel is not what it seems to be with demons roaming around. You must escape the hotel alive while also uncovering dark secrets as you progress.

[from [url=https://jooshuar.itch.io/demon-hotel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一家看起来很原始的酒店醒来，但后来发现酒店并不像看上去的那样，恶魔在四处游荡。你必须活着逃离酒店，同时随着你的进展揭开黑暗的秘密。

[来自[url=https://jooshuar.itch.io/demon-hotel]Itch.io[/url]]
